scope: R085 worker evidence helper errors; separate from the single fixture campaign result

errors.detail: The importlib-loaded module was not registered in sys.modules; the dataclass decorator raised AttributeError because the module lookup returned None.
collect_source_identity completed, then the wrapper comparator asked for result key files instead of currentFiles and raised KeyError.

The binding hashtable used (if(...)) as a value; PowerShell treated if as a command and stopped before writing the sidecar. The campaign process had already exited; this did not trigger a replay or affect cleanup.
